verdict.rationale: The 01 is itself an AI assistant platform powered by Open Interpreter. Its documented assistant takes natural-language voice input and carries out tasks: executing code, browsing the web, managing files and controlling third-party software. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that delegated tasks complete reliably, and documentation of multi-step task delegation and oversight.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Assistants powered by the 01 can execute code, browse the web, read and create files, control third-party software, and beyond.
It processes input, executes commands, generates responses, and manages core logic using Open Interpreter.
Powered by Open Interpreter, it provides a natural language voice interface for computers.
